code.DUPLICATE_VALUE: There is already an entry with this value.
code.STILL_REFERENCED: The entry is still in use and therefore cannot be deleted.
code.STILL_REFERENCED_BY: The entry is still in use and therefore cannot be deleted permanently. Still attached to it: {blockers}.
code.MISSING_REFERENCE: A linked entry no longer exists.
code.CONFLICT: The action is not possible in the current state.
code.INTERNAL: An error occurred on the server.
code.INVALID_REFRESH_TOKEN: The session has expired. Please sign in again.
code.INVALID_SETUP_TOKEN: The setup token is not valid.
code.SETUP_ALREADY_DONE: The initial setup has already been completed.
code.INVOICES_WRONG_ACCOUNT: These invoices do not belong to the insured person of the policy: {invoices}.
code.INVOICES_ALREADY_SUBMITTED: These invoices have already been submitted under this policy: {invoices}.
code.INVOICES_EXCLUDED: These invoices are marked as not reimbursable under this policy: {invoices}.
code.INVOICES_ALREADY_BILLED: These invoices are already marked as settled: {invoices}.
code.INVOICES_NOT_COVERED: These invoices are marked as not covered and will not be submitted: {invoices}.
code.INVOICES_NOT_SUBMITTED_HERE: These invoices have not been submitted under the policy of this service billing: {invoices}.
code.REIMBURSEMENT_EXCEEDS_INVOICE: The reimbursements would exceed the invoice amount: {invoices}.
code.INVOICE_AMOUNT_BELOW_REIMBURSED: The invoice amount cannot drop below the amounts already reimbursed.
code.INVOICE_NOT_SUBMITTED: Only a submitted invoice can be marked as settled.
code.INVOICE_ALREADY_SUBMITTED: The invoice has already been submitted under this policy.
code.INVOICE_ALREADY_EXCLUDED: The invoice is already marked as not reimbursable under this policy.
code.CONTRACT_ACCOUNT_MISMATCH: The policy belongs to a different insured person than the invoice.
code.TREATMENT_DAYS_DIFFERENT_YEARS: All treatment days of an invoice must fall in the same calendar year. Please create a second invoice for the other year — the same invoice number may appear twice.
code.INVOICE_NOT_COVERED_REASON_REQUIRED: Please give a short reason why the invoice is not covered — it is what the mark is for.
code.INVOICE_NOT_COVERED_SUBMITTED: An invoice that has already been submitted cannot be marked as not covered. Please withdraw the submission first, or set the mark for the individual policy.
code.INVOICE_ACCOUNT_NOT_OF_AGENCY: The selected bank details do not belong to this billing agency. Please choose one of its bank details.
code.INVOICE_HAS_REIMBURSEMENT: A reimbursement has already been booked for this invoice under this policy; it can no longer be withdrawn.
code.BILLING_NUMBER_TAKEN: Service billing {billingNumber} already exists for this policy.

HISTORY_BEFORE_CONTRACT.premium: A premium record cannot start before the policy begins.

HISTORY_AFTER_CONTRACT.terms: Terms cannot start after the policy ends.
HISTORY_AFTER_CONTRACT.premium: A premium record cannot start after the policy ends.

HISTORY_START_EXISTS.terms: There are already terms for this year.
HISTORY_START_EXISTS.premium: There is already a premium record for this date.

code.YEAR_OUTSIDE_CONTRACT: The year lies outside the policy term.
code.PARENT_IN_TRASH: {parent} is in the trash as well. Please restore it first.
code.RESTORE_CONFLICT: There is now another entry with the same value.
code.SELF_ACCOUNT_ACTION: This action is not possible for your own account.
code.LAST_ADMIN: The last active administrator cannot be removed or deactivated.
code.USER_NOT_DELETED: This user is not deleted. Please reload the page — the list is out of date.
code.SETTING_UNKNOWN: The application does not know this setting. Please reload the page and try again.
code.SETTING_READONLY: The application writes this value itself; it cannot be set.
code.SETTING_INVALID_VALUE: The value for “{label}” does not fit.
code.SETTING_INVALID_VALUE_UNNAMED: The value does not fit this setting.
code.SETTINGS_ENCRYPTION_UNAVAILABLE: Passwords and tokens cannot be stored without the key CONFIG_ENCRYPTION_KEY in the server environment.
code.MAIL_NOT_CONFIGURED: Sending email is not fully set up. Please check that it is enabled and that the mail server and sender address are filled in.
code.MAIL_SEND_FAILED: The mail server refused to send: {reason}
code.MAIL_SEND_FAILED_UNNAMED: Sending through the configured mail server failed.
code.REMINDERS_DISABLED: Payment reminders are switched off. Without them, a run sends nothing.
code.RETENTION_DISABLED: The retention period is switched off. The dry run still shows what it would remove.
